method.snapshot: Two clean, compact snapshots of the same current working copy; only entry routing and skill descriptions differed.
limits: One run per task and variant is too small for a stable token-cost estimate.
Input totals include cached tokens; uncached input moved in the opposite direction overall.
The compact snapshots omitted large content-audit packages, so both variants treated linked raw packages as unavailable.
This measures plan routing and evidence selection, not implementation correctness or observed-user outcomes.

aggregate.interpretation: Overall routing became faster and used fewer tool calls, but a billing or token-cost reduction is not established because uncached input increased and cache behavior varied.

tasks.request: Plan a one-typo correction in docs/harness/QA.md.
tasks.assessment: Equivalent correct scope and docs:check. Light correctly skipped agent.md, but token use did not fall.

tasks.request: Plan one fallback-title wording change and its owning test.
tasks.assessment: Equivalent final scope and test ownership. Light over-searched with a broad rg and regressed on time and tool calls.

tasks.request: Plan preservation of undated Items while excluding them from VEVENT output.
tasks.assessment: Both found the canonical Item/projection rule and export ownership. Light made source versus personal overlay boundaries more explicit.

tasks.request: Plan a Korean visual HTML review of same-date multi-Flow calendar identity.
tasks.assessment: Both selected report, UX review, browser QA, and calendar ownership evidence. Light was shorter and faster without a material evidence gap.

tasks.request: Determine current Stage, next priority, and the human decision needed now.
tasks.assessment: Both selected session-start and release-readiness, separated production green from 0 observed-user sessions, and reached the same owner-decision gate.

tasks.request: Plan a release review separating implementation, QA, deployment, and observed users.
tasks.assessment: Both preserved the four evidence lanes. Light omitted session-start as a selected skill but inspected equivalent baseline evidence and avoided extensive duplicate reads.

quality_gate.manual_pair_review: 6/6 retained the material conclusion, ownership boundary, and required verification
quality_gate.minor_difference: One full release task omitted session-start as a named skill; one micro task over-searched despite the lighter entry rule.

apply_now: Make agent.md conditional for clear low-risk local work.
Shorten nine skill discovery descriptions while preserving all skill bodies.
Keep hooks, CI, workflow scripts, canonical product documents, and specialist knowledge unchanged.
do_not_apply: Do not delete or merge skills from this experiment.
Do not claim stable token-cost savings from one run per pair.
decision.recheck: Review the next 10 normal tasks, with special attention to micro-task search breadth and full release/session-start routing.
